commits.message: fix(safety): add data-logo-moon to all ☾ logo elements for SOS triple-tap
fix(safety): make SOS activation stealth — remove red fullscreen overlay
fix(privacy): reduce LocationCard coord precision from 11m to 1km (SEC-002)
fix(safety): auto-block user on report — match UI promise in ReportSheet
commits.note: committed on fix/p0-critical-2026-05-07 to avoid conflict with parallel builder

commits.message: fix(a11y): WCAG contrast fixes — gradient-text, link color, gradient-bg text-shadow
fix(a11y): restore reducedMotion='user' in MotionConfig — WCAG 2.3.3

priorities_implemented.audit_finding: FIX A — SOS triple-tap dead (P0 SAFETY)
priorities_implemented.approach: Added data-logo-moon attribute to TopNav brand logo span and FABMenu moon glyph (conditional: only when showing ☾, not +). SOSButton was already listening for [data-logo-moon] via document event delegation.

priorities_implemented.audit_finding: FIX B — SOS red fullscreen overlay visible to aggressor (P0 SAFETY)
priorities_implemented.approach: Complete rewrite of SOSButton. Removed AnimatePresence red overlay. New: navigator.vibrate([200,100,200]) + 2s auto-dismissing toast (bottom-right, 80% black, small font) + fire-and-forget triggerSOS(). Screen shows nothing to observer.

priorities_implemented.audit_finding: FIX C — LocationCard 11m precision leak in chat (P0 PRIVACY)
priorities_implemented.approach: toFixed(4) → toFixed(2) on display label. ~11m → ~1.1km precision. Google Maps link unchanged (full precision for navigation intent). Consistent with SEC-002.

priorities_implemented.audit_finding: FIX D — Report does not auto-block (P0 SAFETY)
priorities_implemented.approach: In reportUser() after successful insert, call blockUser(reportedUserId, 'auto-block:report:<reason>'). blockUser uses upsert so idempotent. Matches UI copy 'Ce profil sera aussi bloqué automatiquement'.

priorities_implemented.audit_finding: FIX E — WCAG contrast failures: gradient-text 2.1:1, links 4.23:1, gradient-bg buttons 1.8:1 (P0 A11Y)
priorities_implemented.approach: gradient-text changed to violet-only #8B5CF6→#6D28D9 (both pass 4.5:1 AA). Added gradient-text-deco class for decorative non-text uses (keeps violet+green). Added --color-link: #7C3AED token (5.23:1 on white). Added text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.35) to gradient-bg for button text contrast boost.

priorities_implemented.audit_finding: FIX F — reducedMotion='never' breaks WCAG 2.3.3 (P0 A11Y)
priorities_implemented.approach: Changed MotionConfig reducedMotion='never' to 'user'. Restores OS prefers-reduced-motion signal to useReducedMotion() hooks across 40+ components. The stuck-opacity-at-0 regression that motivated 'never' is handled by CSS @media (prefers-reduced-motion) 0.01ms clamp + .cesoir-reduced-motion class.

next_steps: Merge PR #49 after review + test with OS Reduce Motion enabled
Verify triple-tap SOS on mobile device (touchend events vs click)
Consider migrating gradient-text usages to gradient-text-deco where decorative (audit needed across 30+ usages)
Inline link colors using text-accent class need manual migration to text-[#7C3AED] or a new text-link Tailwind token
